shared_elements: upright stone monument carved in low relief
frontal anthropomorphic figure with elaborate headdress-like upper zone
bilateral symmetry about a vertical axis
justification: Both are tall, vertically oriented stone monuments organised symmetrically into stacked zones, with an ornate headdress-like mass at the top over a frontal body and a prominent disc on the chest area, which is a genuinely comparable compositional scheme. The rendering, however, is very different: A is sparse, shallow and worn, with a few isolated motifs floating on a broad boulder-like surface, while B is densely and crisply packed edge-to-edge with interlocking figures and block-like sign clusters on a cylindrical shaft.
